population_by_zip_<N>: Holds population counts by ZIP (one row per zipcode and demographic bucket) — grain: one row per geo_id/zipcode/minimum_age/maximum_age/gender; keys/measures: geo_id, zipcode, minimum_age, maximum_age, gender, population.
maneuver_<N>: Holds driver maneuvers to avoid events (one row per state_number/consecutive_number/vehicle_number) — grain: one row per vehicle maneuver record; keys/measures: state_number, state_name, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, driver_maneuvered_to_avoid, driver_maneuvered_to_avoid_name.
vsoe_<N>: Holds vehicle sequence-of-events and impact areas (one row per state_number/consecutive_number/vehicle_number/vehicle_event_number) — grain: one row per vehicle event in the sequence; keys/measures: state_number, state_name, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, vehicle_event_number, sequence_of_events, sequence_of_events_name, area_of_Impact_associated_with_the_event, area_of_Impact_associated_with_the_event_name.
safetyeq_<N>: Holds detailed non-motorist protective equipment flags per person (one row per state_number/consecutive_number/vehicle_number/person_number) — grain: one row per person; keys/measures: state_number, state_name, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, person_number, nm_helmet, nm_helmet_name, nm_propad, nm_propad_name, nm_othpro, nm_othpro_name, nm_refclo, nm_refclo_name, nm_light, nm_light_name, nm_othpre, nm_othpre_name.
nmcrash_<N>: Holds non-motorist contributing circumstances (one row per state_number/consecutive_number/vehicle_number/person_number) — grain: one row per non-motorist involved; keys/measures: state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, person_number, non_motorist_contributing_circumstances, non_motorist_contributing_circumstances_name.
drimpair_<N>: Holds driver impairment condition at crash time (one row per state_number/consecutive_number/vehicle_number) — grain: one row per vehicle/driver impairment record; keys/measures: state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, condition_impairment_at_time_of_crash_driver, condition_impairment_at_time_of_crash_driver_name.
distract_<N>: Driver distraction rows: one row per distracting instance (grain = state_number + consecutive_number + vehicle_number) with keys state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number and measures driver_distracted_by and driver_distracted_by_name
person_<N>: Person-level or occupant rows: one row per person in crash (grain = state_number + consecutive_number + vehicle_number + person_number) with keys state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, person_number and measures/attributes including number_of_motor_vehicles_in_transport_mvit, number_of_motor_vehicle_striking_non_motorist, county, crash time fields (day_of_crash, month_of_crash, hour_of_crash, minute_of_crash), land_use/land_use_name, functional_system/functional_system_name, first_harmful_event/first_harmful_event_name, manner_of_collision/manner_of_collision_name, school_bus_related, vehicle_make/vehicle_make_name, make_model_combined, body_type/body_type_name, vehicle_trailing, special_use/special_use_name, emergency_motor_vehicle_use, rollover, initial_contact_point/initial_contact_point_name, fire_occurrence, age, sex, person_type/person_type_name, injury_severity/injury_severity_name, seating_position
factor_<N>: Contributing factor rows: one row per vehicle contributing circumstance (grain = state_number + consecutive_number + vehicle_number) with keys state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number and fields contributing_circumstances_motor_vehicle and contributing_circumstances_motor_vehicle_name
damage_<N>: Damage area rows: one row per vehicle damage record (grain = state_number + consecutive_number + vehicle_number) with keys state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number and fields damaged_areas and damaged_areas_name
accident_<N>: Accident-level records: one row per crash (grain = crash identified by state_number + consecutive_number) with keys state_number, state_name, consecutive_number and measures/attributes such as county, county_name, city, city_name, day_of_crash, month_of_crash, year_of_crash, day_of_week, hour_of_crash, minute_of_crash, latitude (and in second variant longitude), milepoint, national_highway_system, route_signing, land_use/land_use_name, functional_system/functional_system_name, ownership/ownership_name, trafficway_identifier(s), special_jurisdiction/special_jurisdiction_name, first_harmful_event/first_harmful_event_name, manner_of_collision/illustrated manner_of_collision_name, number_of_vehicle_forms_submitted_all, number_of_motor_vehicles_in_transport_mvit, number_of_parked_working_vehicles, number_of_forms_submitted_for_persons_in_motor_vehicles, number_of_persons_in_motor_vehicles_in_transport_mvit, number_of_forms_submitted_for_persons_not_in_motor_vehicles, number_of_persons_not_in_motor_vehicles_in_transport_mvit
pbtype_<N>: Holds non-motorist (pedestrian/bicyclist) person records; grain = one row per non-motorist per crash (state_number, consecutive_number, person_number, vehicle_number); notable keys/measures: person_type, person_type_name, age, sex, marked_crosswalk_present, sidewalk_present, school_zone, crash_type_pedestrian/crash_type_pedestrian_name, crash_type_bicycle/crash_type_bicycle_name, crash_location_pedestrian, crash_location_bicycle, pedestrian_position, bicyclist_position, pedestrian_initial_direction_of_travel, bicyclist_initial_direction_of_travel, motorist_initial_direction_of_travel, motorist_maneuver, intersection_leg, pedestrian_scenario/pedestrian_scenario_name, crash_group_pedestrian/crash_group_pedestrian_name, crash_group_bicycle/crash_group_bicycle_name
violatn_<N>: Holds charged violations per vehicle in a crash; grain = one row per vehicle per crash (state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number); notable keys/measures: violations_charged, violations_charged_name
vevent_<N>: Holds vehicle-event sequence/impact records; grain = one row per event involvement (state_number, consecutive_number, event_number, vehicle_number, vehicle_event_number); notable keys/measures: vehicle_number_this_vehicle, area_of_impact_this_vehicle/area_of_impact_this_vehicle_name, sequence_of_events/sequence_of_events_name, vehicle_number_other_vehicle/vehicle_number_other_vehicle_name, area_of_impact_other_vehicle/area_of_impact_other_vehicle_name, state_name
parkwork_<N>: Holds vehicle-level parked/work/motor-vehicle and basic crash attributes (detailed variant with state_name); grain = one row per vehicle per crash (state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number); notable keys/measures: number_of_motor_vehicles_in_transport_mvit, number_of_occupants/number_of_occupants_name, day_of_crash/day_of_crash_name, month_of_crash/month_of_crash_name, hour_of_crash/hour_of_crash_name, minute_of_crash/minute_of_crash_name, first_harmful_event/first_harmful_event_name, manner_of_collision/manner_of_collision_name, unit_type/unit_type_name, hit_and_run/hit_and_run_name, registration_state/registration_state_name, registered_vehicle_owner/registered_vehicle_owner_name, vehicle_make/vehicle_make_name, vehicle_model, make_model_combined, body_type/body_type_name, vehicle_model_year, vehicle_identification_number_vin, vin_character_1..vin_character_3
nmimpair_<N>: Holds non-motorist impairment condition records; grain = one row per non-motorist per crash (state_number, consecutive_number, person_number, vehicle_number); notable keys/measures: condition_impairment_at_time_of_crash_non_motorist, condition_impairment_at_time_of_crash_non_motorist_name
nmprior_<N>: Holds non-motorist prior-action records; grain = one row per non-motorist action (one per state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, person_number); notable keys/measures = state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, person_number, non_motorist_action_circumstances, non_motorist_action_circumstances_name.
vehicle_<N>: Holds vehicle-level records for crashes; grain = one row per vehicle (one per state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number); notable keys/measures = state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, number_of_motor_vehicles_in_transport_mvit, number_of_occupants, day_of_crash, month_of_crash, hour_of_crash, minute_of_crash, first_harmful_event, first_harmful_event_name, manner_of_collision, unit_type, hit_and_run, registration_state, registration_state_name, registered_vehicle_owner, registered_vehicle_owner_name, vehicle_make, vehicle_make_name, vehicle_model, make_model_combined, body_type, body_type_name, vehicle_model_year, vehicle_identification_number_vin, vin_character_1, vin_character_2, vin_character_3, vin_character_4, vin_character_5, vin_character_6, vin_character_7, vin_character_8, vin_character_9, vin_character_10, vin_character_11, vin_character_12, vehicle_trailing, jackknife.
cevent_<N>: Holds collision event details linking vehicles and impact areas; grain = one row per event involvement (one per state_number, consecutive_number, event_number, vehicle_number_this_vehicle); notable keys/measures = state_number, consecutive_number, event_number, vehicle_number_this_vehicle, area_of_impact_this_vehicle, area_of_impact_this_vehicle_name, sequence_of_events, sequence_of_events_name, vehicle_number_other_vehicle, area_of_impact_other_vehicle, area_of_impact_other_vehicle_name.
us_states_area: Holds US state geographic and identifier attributes; grain = one row per state/territory (one per state_fips_code/state_geo_id); notable keys/measures = region_code, division_code, state_fips_code, state_gnis_code, state_geo_id, state_abbreviation, state_name, legal_area_code, feature_class_code, functional_status_code, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_lat, internal_point_lon, state_geom.
us_border_area: Holds US border geography records; grain = one row per border feature (one per name/geo_id); notable keys/measures = name, geo_id, aff_geo_id, us_border_geom.
us_msa_area: Holds metropolitan statistical area geometry and codes; grain = one row per MSA/CSA record (one per msa_code/csa_code/geo_code); notable keys/measures = csa_code, msa_code, geo_code, name, lsad_name, lsad_code, status_indicator, feature_class_code, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, int_point_lat, int_point_lon, msa_geom.
us_cities_area: Holds urban area / city geographic records; grain = one row per city/urban area (one per urban_area_code/geo_code); notable keys/measures = urban_area_code, geo_code, name, lsad_name, lsad_code, feature_class_code, area_type, functional_status, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, int_point_lat, int_point_lon, city_geom.
zipcode_area: Holds ZIP-code geography and basic place attributes; grain = one row per zipcode (one per zipcode); notable keys/measures = zipcode, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, area_land_miles, area_water_miles, latitude, longitude, state_code, state_name, city, county, state_fips, zipcode_geom.
country_code_iso: Holds country identifier codes; grain = one row per country (one per country_name/alpha_2_code); notable keys/measures = country_name, fips_code, alpha_2_code, alpha_3_code, numeric_code, stanag_code, cctlds, continent_code, continent_name, sub_continent_name.
num_<N>: Simple numeric lookup table; grain = one row per numeric value; notable keys/measures = num.
time: Holds time-of-day decomposed values; grain = one row per time value (one per time); notable keys/measures = time, hour, minute, second, second_in_day, hour_ampm, is_pm.
date_greg: Holds Gregorian calendar date decompositions and formats; grain = one row per calendar date (one per date/date_int); notable keys/measures = date, date_str, date_int, date_dash, date_slash, day, day_abbr, dow_mon17, dow_mon06, dow_sun17, dow_sun06, week_mon, week_sun, week_iso, month, month_abbr, month_first_day, quarter, quarter_first_day, half, half_first_day, year, year_iso, year_first_day.
us_coastline_area: Holds US coastline features; grain = one row per named coastline segment (one row per name) with columns name and coastline_geom (geometry of the coastline segment).
us_county_area: Holds US county geographic areas; grain = one row per county (identified by state_fips_code + county_fips_code / geo_id) with keys/identifiers state_fips_code, county_fips_code, county_gnis_code, aff_geo_code, geo_id, county_name, legal_area_code and measures area_land_meters, area_water_meters plus county_geom (geometry).
us_csa_area: Holds Combined Statistical Area (CSA) geographic areas; grain = one row per CSA (identified by csa_code, aff_geo_code, geo_code) with name and lsad_code and measures area_land_meters, area_water_meters plus csa_geom (geometry).
